venue.name: Ardgillan Orangery
venue.reception_location: Terrace (moves to the Long Gallery if the Wednesday 18 November forecast shows more than 40% chance of rain)

seating.notes: Provisional layout: one top table of up to 12 plus thirteen round tables of 10, subject to room capacity. Fionnuala Ó Dálaigh is at the left end because she is left-handed. Which side 'left' means is awaiting client confirmation, so the layout must be able to flip. The remaining top table names are not yet supplied. No raised dais or steps for the top table. Przemysław Grzybowski needs a table with clear space for his chair, on a step-free route and away from the kitchen door and from the backs of other tables. Any stage needs a ramp.

bar.alcohol_from: Not before the keynote has actually ended and never before 20:30. If the keynote overruns, the bar stays closed until it ends. Reception drinks are non-alcoholic only, with no pre-poured or pre-set wine, in either location.

transport.provider: TBC (coach company still to be selected; Coachline excluded and must not be approached or subcontracted)

accessibility: Step-free route from drop-off and parking to the terrace, keynote space, dining room, Long Gallery and an accessible toilet, to be confirmed in writing by the venue
Ground surfaces and outdoor lighting on the route to be confirmed as suitable
Ramps and lifts with dimensions to be confirmed in writing
Wheelchair evacuation plan to be confirmed in writing
Any stage or dais to have a ramp; top table not raised on steps
Coach with wheelchair lift and securement points, or an accessible alternative
Coach pick-up and drop-off point step-free and close to the entrance
